name: Cash Parties 43
definition: Specifies cash parties in the framework of a corporate action event.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party to which an amount of money is due.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

MarketClaimCounterparty.name: Market Claim Counterparty
MarketClaimCounterparty.definition: Party that has reimbursed the account owner with funds to which they were legally entitled.
